title: The Four Great Clans
summary: Crowds gather at the Great Desolate Ancient Tablet, where Mu Qianqian tells Teng Lei, young master of the Yin Puppet Sect, that Lin Dong has left. Teng Lei senses Hua Zong's Mental Strength on Lin Dong and attacks him anyway. Then the Four Great Clans arrive: Lin Langtian of the Lin Clan with Lin Ke-er, the Qin Clan, Huangpu Jing of the Huangpu Clan and Wang Yan of the Wang Clan. Lin Langtian calls Lin Dong a branch-family nobody and lets Wang Yan, now Qi Creation initial, deal with him. Lin Dong beats Wang Yan with the Subduing Golden Platform Magic Palm, a Wang family art he uses better than Wang Yan does. When Wang Yan's elder, Wang Tong, steps in, Lin Dong shames Lin Langtian in front of everyone for bowing to the Wang Clan, and Elder Lin Mu stops Lin Langtian from seizing him. The tablet opens and everyone heads inside.
events: At the tablet, Mu Qianqian fends off Teng Lei, young master of the Yin Puppet Sect, and claims Lin Dong has left.
Teng Lei senses Hua Zong's Mental Strength on Lin Dong and attacks him, meaning to turn him into a Symbol Puppet.
The Four Great Clans arrive: Lin Langtian, Lin Ke-er, the Qin Clan, Huangpu Jing and Wang Yan.
Lin Langtian disowns Lin Dong as branch-family trash and lets Wang Yan settle his score.
Lin Dong beats Wang Yan with the Subduing Golden Platform Magic Palm and the Great Sun Thunder Body.
Wang Tong steps in; Lin Dong calls Lin Langtian a traitor to his clan, and Elder Lin Mu stops Lin Langtian from seizing him.
The ancient tablet opens and the Four Great Clans lead the crowd inside.
cultivation: Wang Yan is Qi Creation initial and Wang Tong is Qi Creation advanced. Little Mink says Lin Langtian is much stronger than a year ago and still beyond Lin Dong. The Lin Clan Gathering is one year away.

places: plaza before the Great Desolate Ancient Tablet

flags: 皇甫: the official English says 'Huangfu' (correct pinyin); names.txt and the wiki say 'Huangpu'. I used the names.txt form (huangpu-jing); change both if the site prefers Huangfu.

654.1-662.6: Lin Dong wonders if 'she' (Ling Qingzhu) has come; someone says the girl is Huangpu Jing, and Lin Dong thinks 'not her'. The line about Ling Qingzhu having mentioned Lin Dong (720.8) is unattributed; it is probably Huangpu Jing.
Qin Shi is not named until EP36 (243.3); here the Qin Clan heir greets Lin Langtian (635.0) and teases Huangpu Jing, and Wang Yan mocks him as effeminate (680.5). That fits Qin Shi.
Wang Tong is called 统叔 / 王长老 here and named 王统 in EP36 (584.6). Lin Mu is called 林穆叔 (1169.0); the wiki has Lin Mu (Lin Clan elder, Half-step Manifestation).
Teng Lei's card 421.0 is his face-to-face line to Lin Dong. He first speaks at 331.1, to Mu Qianqian.
Gu Yan is in the crowd (243.8, 冤家路窄), with Ancient Sword Sect men.
Realm mapping 小成 = 'Qi Creation initial', 大成 = 'Qi Creation advanced'; see the EP29 flag.
Lin Dong uses the Subduing Golden Platform Magic Palm; Wang Yan exclaims it is a Wang family martial art (968.0).
changes: First review for this episode; no older summary to correct.
